Committee: Education Policy
Sponsor: Hurst
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 04/06/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 572 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of local school boards to compile and maintain work-based learning opportunities for students, to provide this information to students during orientation, and to publish this formation on the boards website and the websites of each school under the jurisdiction of the board.
Terri Collins, Chair
Education Policy
